title.en: Our Lips Are Sealed names the sections; Electric 80 Concrete Pump keeps the printed cells
title.zh: 《Our Lips Are Sealed》只提供章节，电动80型混凝土泵仍用已印格子

description.en: The Electric 80 Concrete Pump note follows the outline of Our Lips Are Sealed. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes Electric 80 Concrete Pump. The published table prints Motor Power 110 kW; Output Capacity 60 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 40 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.7 m³; Pumping Distance (H / V) 900 m / 300 m; Max. Aggregate Size 24 mm (≤ 2 cm); Hydraulic Pump Kawasaki 140 double pump; Dimensions (L×W×H) 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm; Main Unit Weight 6000 kg. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.
description.zh: 电动80型混凝土泵这篇笔记顺着《Our Lips Are Sealed》的大纲写。邢台河北品锦机械公布电动80型混凝土泵。已公布参数表印有：电机功率110 kW；理论输送量60 m³/h；最大出口压力40 MPa；料斗容积0.7 m³；输送距离（水平/垂直）900 m / 300 m；最大骨料粒径24 mm (≤ 2 cm)；液压泵Kawasaki 140 double pump；外形尺寸6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm；整机重量6000 kg。没有印出、因此留空的栏目：缸径、活塞行程、使用寿命、材料牌号。内容照片不会补上参数表没有的数字。
